# fold

Wrap long input lines through MoonX.

## Usage

```sh
moonx cli/fold -w 40 input.txt

moonx cli/fold -s -w 40 input.txt
```

Wrap at 80 columns by default. -s prefers whitespace breaks; -b counts raw bytes.

## Common options

<!-- BEGIN GENERATED OPTIONS -->
<!-- Generated by tools/metadata from options.json. -->

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `-b`, `--bytes` | count bytes rather than columns |
| `-c`, `--characters` | count characters in the C-locale byte profile |
| `-s`, `--spaces` | break after the last available blank |
| `-w VALUE`, `--width VALUE` | Set the output width. Default: `80`. |
| `--help` | Show help. |
| `--version` | Show the version. |
<!-- END GENERATED OPTIONS -->

## Notes

Workspace builds use the MoonBit 2026-11-26 toolchain.

- Default column handling recognizes byte-level tabs and control characters, not Unicode display width.

See the [compatibility guide](../../docs/compatibility.md) for the supported profile.
